last_episode_to_air.overview: A death at sea with unexplained injuries stirs rumours about a legendary sea monster, the Lusca. Meanwhile, Mervin is blindsided by an unexpected young visitor.

tmdb.name: Death in Paradise
tmdb.overview: A brilliant but idiosyncratic British detective and his resourceful local team solve baffling murder mysteries on the fictional Caribbean island of Saint Marie.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: DI Richard Poole hates the sun, sea, and sand, so he is less than pleased when he is sent to a tiny island on Caribbean to solve a mysterious murder. And awaiting him is a ramshackle station and a very different type of policing.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: Still trapped on the stunning Saint-Marie, DI Richard Poole and the unorthodox team are tasked to tackle a baffling array of unique murders on this otherwise Caribbean paradise.

seasons.name: Season 3
seasons.overview: A shocking murder may have the new detective Goodman stumped, but would his razor-sharp insight into crime solving win the team round and prove he's the man for the job?

seasons.name: Season 4
seasons.overview: The endearingly clumsy but brilliant DI Humphrey is here to stay as these testing murder cases are more mystifying than ever. But could he contain his feelings for DS Camille Bordey?

seasons.name: Season 5
seasons.overview: DI Goodman's love life might be lacking, but his considerable intellect and experience are tested to the full, as he faces some of Saint Marie's most perplexing murders yet.

seasons.name: Season 6
seasons.overview: DI Humphrey's new found romance is met with more untimely tropical murders and fiendishly difficult puzzles on the sun-soaked Saint Marie.

seasons.name: Season 7
seasons.overview: Joining the team at the stunning Saint Marie is DI Jack Mooney. He may be brilliant, but he'll need all his instinctive genius to solve all the impossible mysteries.

seasons.name: Season 10
seasons.overview: The smash-hit whodunit returns with DI Neville Parker solving a slew of mysterious murders under the sultry Caribbean sun. And some big surprises are in store.

seasons.name: Season 14
seasons.overview: We're transported back to the tropical island of Saint Marie, and this time with a new Detective Inspector in place - but will DI Mervin Wilson remain in the job for long? Following the recently cracked case of ‘who shot the Santas?’, along with the revelation that his estranged mother has passed away, Mervin is ready to get back home and leave the island for good. But when a case close to the hearts of those at the station presents itself, is he tempted to extend his stay?

results.name: Death in paradise - Trailer - Original Version

results.overview: Filmed on location at Santa Monica and Venice Beach, this series focuses on an elite bike cop unit of the LAPD.
results.name: Pacific Blue

results.overview: Kapitan Sowa na tropie is a Polish series from 1965 directed by Stanisław Bareja. It was the first Polish criminal series made after World War II.
results.name: Kapitan Sowa na tropie

results.original_name: มีสติหน่อยคุณธีร์
results.overview: An introverted photographer's life changes when a former mafia boss hires him for love advice, only to end up falling for him instead.
results.name: Me and Thee

results.overview: Wrongfully imprisoned for murdering his own son, a father sets out on a desperate rescue mission after learning the boy may still be alive.
results.name: I Will Find You

results.overview: Angel Street is an American crime drama series broadcast  on CBS from September 15—October 3, 1992. Starring Robin Givens and Pamela Gidley as two Chicago homicide detectives, the series was canceled after four episodes aired, leaving four unaired.
results.name: Angel Street

results.overview: Mike McNeil is a decorated New York City detective whose toughest assignment is himself. He's struggling to balance a challenging personal life with a job that leaves him wondering on a daily basis if he is the last sane person in New York. His unconventional approach to his job makes him a great cop, even on the most trying days. The only thing he can't figure out is why, if he's the only sane guy around, everyone's always looking at him like he's crazy.
results.name: The Job

results.overview: Dateline NBC, or simply Dateline, is a weekly American television newsmagazine series. It was previously the network's flagship newsmagazine, but now focuses mainly on true crime stories with only occasional editions that focus on other topics.
results.name: Dateline

results.overview:
Revolves around a fictional elite crime unit of the Honolulu Police Department headed by veteran detective and local legend Sean Harrison and John Declan, a former Chicago Police Department detective transferred to the state of Hawaii for his talents.

The series was canceled in October 2004. Although eight episodes were filmed, only seven actually aired.
results.name: Hawaii

results.overview: When an unidentified body is found in a luxury apartment linked to Oliver Kennedy and his girlfriend Ciara Wyse, Detectives Lee Reardon and Karl Connolly reconstruct the couple's deadly romance across the past 56 days.
results.name: 56 Days

results.overview: A stern officer and a sharp-witted investigator form a detective duo that solves eerie murders and uncovers corruption within the Tang Dynasty.
results.name: Unveil: Jadewind

results.original_name: ไขคดีเป็น เห็นคดีตาย
results.overview: When seven college students find themselves trapped in a deadly game, two detectives compete to find the killer — even as their attraction grows.
results.name: Dare You to Death

results.original_name: アイシー～瞬間記憶捜査・柊班～
results.overview: Hizuki Hiiragi, a detective with the unique ability to recall scenes like photographs, is known as the Ice Queen for her relentless pursuit of criminals. As she solves cases with a team of eccentric detectives, she must confront a painful past she’s determined to forget.
results.name: Frame of Mind

results.overview: Police drama set in New York City, exploring the internal and external struggles of the fictional 15th precinct of Manhattan. Each episode typically intertwined several plots involving an ensemble cast.
results.name: NYPD Blue

results.overview: Oslo detectives Max  Sørensen and Sander Holm are called in to investigate after four young immigrant boys are found dead in an empty swimming pool. Bizarre twists in the case brings the detectives face to face with both their own demons and a dark sequence of increasingly inexplicable events.
results.name: Seizure

results.overview: Takashi Oshii is a detective with excellent reasoning power. Unfortunately, he usually misses the criminal in front of him and other detectives get recognition for the capture. He is transferred to the Utobashi Police Station. Takashi Oshii goes to a record company CEO's house. The CEO's third son was burned to death. The police are set to conclude that his death was an accident, but Takashi Oshii thinks otherwise. Takashi Oshii begins to investigate.
results.name: So Close! Detective Oshii

results.overview: Based partially on such blockbuster American TV series as "The X-Files" and "CSI", "Mystic Detective Files" explores the themes of supernatural existence and unsolved mysteries, as a forensic investigator, a former undercover cop, and a police psychiatrist must work together to solve a series of unusual deaths that may or may not have to do with paranormal activities.
results.name: Mystic Detective Files

results.overview: The story of how Detective Superintendent Steve Fulcher deliberately breached police procedure and protocol to catch a killer, a decision that ultimately cost him his career and reputation.
results.name: A Confession

results.overview: Documentary following joint police and paramedic fast response units, with both emergency services travelling together in one high-performance vehicle.
results.name: 999: Emergency Call Out

omdb.Title: Death in Paradise
omdb.Actors: Elizabeth Bourgine, Don Warrington, Danny John-Jules
omdb.Plot: Sent to a Caribbean Island to investigate a murder, a Scotland Yard detective, Inspector Poole, ends up being semi-permanently stationed there. While most people would regard this as ideal, just about everything about the island disagrees with Poole.
